sentences.en: To the latter he replies by asserting that, "just as the navigating steersman never looses the helm, so does God never remove his care from the world."
sentences.vi: Sau đó, ông trả lời bằng cách khẳng định rằng, ""cũng như người lái tàu định hướng không bao giờ mất quyền chỉ huy, thì Chúa cũng không bao giờ loại bỏ sự quan tâm của ông ấy khỏi thế giới.""

sentences.en: Martignac was dismissed; and Prince Jules de Polignac, the very incarnation of clericalism and reaction, was called to the helm of state.
sentences.vi: Martignac bị sa thải; và Hoàng tử Jules de Polignac, hiện thân của chủ nghĩa giáo sĩ và phản động, được gọi lên vị trí lãnh đạo nhà nước.

sentences.en: Disco, speechless with amazement, rose up and sprang to the helm.
sentences.vi: Disco, không nói nên lời vì kinh ngạc, đứng dậy và vươn lên vị trí lãnh đạo.

sentences.en: Director Simon Wells has done an above average job with his first stint at the helm.

sentences.en: A handful of female imams (priests), considered unthinkable in Islamic countries, are at the helm of this change.

sentences.en: These might feature cute animals at the helm of a sailboat, or children as the captain of the boats.

sentences.en: On January 11, 2008, Maharishi retired from his position after 50 years at the helm of this vastly successful organization.

sentences.en: The plus size clothing market is still evolving and emerging as a powerful trend setter with plus size women at the helm of demand.

sentences.en: The game had such notable contributors as Hironobu Sakaguchi of the established Final Fantasy series and Akira Toriyama at the helm of character design who created the Dragon Ball crew.
